inShort: A and B dink cross-court into the front of the kitchen and take every ball they can out of the air. First to 11.
rules: A and B stand diagonally across at the kitchen line. Mark the front three quarters of each kitchen with cones or shoes.
Dink cross-court and keep every ball in front of the marks, not deep.
A ball that lands behind the marks or outside the kitchen is a point for the other player. The rally goes on.
Take every ball you can out of the air. Each one is a bonus point.
When the ball comes fast, get softer and slower, and keep your belly button behind the ball.
First to 11, then play the other diagonal.
tooEasy: Shrink the target to the front half of the kitchen. Even harder: either of you may dink deep on purpose, so the other has to take it out of the air.
tooHard: Play without points and count dinks in a row that land in front of the marks.
goodLooksLike: Most dinks land in front of the marks, and both of you take balls out of the air instead of stepping back.

drill.title: Cross-Court Dink Rally with Target Zone
